title: 第一百三十七章 激战青龙第一百三十六章 重回矿场
content_zh:
第一百三十七章激战青龙
秦枫只看了一眼，就知道这是一幅详尽的矿道图，而那条向南延伸的长线，正是同盟会暗中开凿、打算用来出逃的隐秘矿道。他没有多言，随手将破布收进储物袋。
待秦家主离开飞舰后，老祖将指间黑子放回棋罐，开口道：“枫儿，我们也该行动了。”
二人没有多言，朝着青龙蛰伏的巨型天坑疾飞而去。
转瞬之间，二人抵达天坑上空，老祖抬手从储物袋中取出三百六十杆阵旗，在灵力操控下阵旗破空四散，分射八方，精准插在天坑四周的山体岩石之上。
旗阵落定刹那，三百六十杆阵旗彼此沟连，引动天地灵气汇聚，一重叠一重的十八角阵图瞬间成型，将这片天地虚空与大地岩层彻底封禁。
大阵开始运转，吸纳而来的精纯灵气顺着阵纹不断汇入老祖体内，老祖的修为气息一刻强过一刻。
地底空间沉睡的青龙被这股强横的封禁之力惊醒，一声苍劲的龙吟自地底深处破空而出。紧接着一条身长近五十丈的青龙自天坑腾飞而出，试图冲破封禁遁走，可刚腾飞至百丈高空，便撞上厚重的大阵结界，冲撞的巨力被结界反弹，庞大的龙躯受反震之力踉跄倒退十余丈。
青龙扭过硕大的头颅，凶戾的目光锁定老祖与秦枫，口吐人言，带着怒意道：“渺小的人族，也敢对本神妄动杀机！”
老祖神色平静，淡淡一笑道：“敢问前辈，与星空青龙族有何渊源？”
青龙心神一震，惊疑的问道：“你是如何知晓星空青龙一族？”
可话音未落，老祖身后虚空陡然撕裂一道空间裂隙，一只青色的龙爪自裂隙中探出，直取老祖后心。
一旁的秦枫反应迅速，储物戒灵光一闪，一颗金色圆球破空而出，瞬息化为十丈大小的金色蜘蛛。右侧四根锋锐的蛛足，凌空向袭来的龙爪斩去。一声刺耳的金铁交鸣，虚空为之震颤。青龙巨爪从虚空裂隙中退走；金丝蛛亦被碰撞的巨力震得后退一丈有余，方才稳住身形。
青龙竖瞳收缩，惊诧道：“竟是半步圣器！没想到你竟然有半步圣器。只可惜你修为不够，只能催动这件圣器七成威能。”
正在此时，大阵灵光涌动，阵纹与老祖周身经脉相连成型。老祖踏入了人即是阵、阵即是人的人阵归一之境，若大法阵也成为了提供灵力的源泉，只要阵法不破，体内灵力便不会枯竭。与此同时，借助阵法加持，老祖的修为也随之攀升到玉清境初期巅峰，周身弥漫的威压席卷八方。
断天刀自老祖丹田内破空而出，老祖右手握刀，全力运转《青木玄火经》心法，精纯的木、火灵力，源源不断的注入断天刀。刀身的赤色玄火陡然暴涨，较之以往威势更盛数倍。
老祖左手掐动阵诀，千万阵纹飞速流转，磅礴的木、火灵力顺着大阵阵纹奔涌而出。
虚空震颤，不计其数的木火长矛凭空凝聚成型，长矛青木为骨、烈焰为锋，密密麻麻遮蔽天穹，如同漫天箭雨倾泻而下，带着摧枯拉朽之势向青龙轰击而去。
青龙仰天长吼，浑厚的龙吼挟带着灼热的龙息，正面迎击漫天袭来的木火长矛。高空中爆裂声连绵不绝，无数木火长矛接连与携带龙息的声波碰撞炸裂，化作漫天星火消散，攻势被尽数化解。
第一百三十七章激战青龙

趁此间隙，老祖紧握断天刀纵身突进，一声断喝：“断岳！”一道十丈的赤色刀芒带着无匹的威能，直劈青龙防御力相对薄弱的腹间要害。
青龙右前爪凌空一抓，正面硬撼袭来的刀芒。赤色刀芒劈在鳞甲之上，金铁交鸣的刺耳声响起。庞大的龙躯只是微微一震；老祖却被巨力反噬，身形连退数丈，方才堪堪稳住身形。
青龙杀意暴涨，左前爪带着劲风向老祖抓来。老祖沟通阵法心念一动，身形化作一道残影避开这致命一抓。随即一声断喝：“裂空！”一道狭长凌厉的赤色刀芒撕裂虚空，直斩龙颈七寸要害。
龙尾横扫而来，撞上赤色刀芒。两股强横力量正面冲撞，群山震颤、云气翻涌，狂暴的灵力冲击波肆意扩散，掀起漫天碎石尘土。
秦枫当即催动丹田内土属性金丹，在体表凝出一层厚重的土黄色灵力光膜，如甲胄般护住全身。随即心念一动，雷丹电光奔涌，噼啪雷弧缠绕全身，身形化作一道电光，下一瞬便出现在青龙腰腹之下的防御薄弱处。
秦枫再度运转金属性金丹内的金灵力，手中寒风双月戟瞬间金光大盛，戟尖外溢的锋锐之气轻易割裂虚空。他全力施展出霸王戟法第七式——吞天灭地。
刹那间长戟化作一条狰狞的金色戟龙，攻势刚猛、势不可挡，狠狠刺在青龙腹间鳞甲之上。一声脆响，坚硬厚实的龙鳞应声碎裂，戟刃深深刺入腹部皮肉之中。
秦枫手中长戟顺势下劈，只听皮肉撕裂之声清晰可闻，坚硬的青龙腹鳞被硬生生剖开一道丈余长的创口，滚烫的龙血顺着伤口喷涌而出，染红了大片虚空。
青龙仰头发出一声吃痛的龙吼。可下一刻，伤口处青色灵光萦绕，喷涌的龙血顷刻止住，受损的皮肉更是以肉眼可见的速度收拢、愈合，巨大的创口转瞬之间便恢复如初。
就在青龙疗伤的间隙，一旁的金丝蛛陡然从左侧发动袭击。伴随着一声嘶鸣，它猛地张口，数万缕金丝喷刺而出，如数万支利箭刺在龙鳞上。
龙鳞表面立时泛起一层厚重的青光，向来锋锐难挡的金丝刺在青光之上，竟无法突破青光防御。但金丝在器灵的操控下，异常灵活，如灵蛇般顺着龙躯游走缠缚。
青龙身躯庞大，四周空间又被大阵禁锢，能活动的空间窄小。纵使它神力滔天，也避无可避，短短数息，腰身便被金丝牢牢捆住。
趁此时机，老祖身形化作一道残影，瞬息间便出现在青龙头顶。他将毕生修为和大阵汇聚的力量，尽数注入手中的断天刀。刀身赤焰翻涌，杀伐之气震荡虚空，只听一声厉喝：“断天！”
一道赤色刀芒带着毁灭之力破空斩落，直取青龙头颅。青龙双目凶光暴涨，怒吼一声，巨口一张，磅礴的龙息喷吐而出。
两股至强力量轰然相撞，大片虚空崩裂，裂痕如蛛网般不断蔓延，一息之后，才慢慢愈合。

Chapter 137 Fierce Battle with Qinglong
Qin Feng only took one glance and knew that this was a detailed map of the mine tunnel, and that the long line extending southward was the secret mine tunnel that the Alliance secretly dug and planned to use to escape. He didn't say anything and just put the rag into the storage bag.
After the Qin family leader left the spaceship, the ancestor put the black pieces between his fingers back into the chess jar and said, "Feng'er, it's time for us to take action."
The two of them said nothing and flew towards the giant sinkhole where the green dragon was dormant.
In an instant, the two reached the sky above the Tiankeng. The ancestor raised his hand and took out three hundred and sixty formation flags from the storage bag. Under the control of spiritual power, the formation flags broke through the air and scattered in all directions, and were accurately planted on the rocks around the Tiankeng.
The moment the flag array was settled, the three hundred and sixty array flags were connected to each other, causing the spiritual energy of the heaven and earth to converge. An overlapping eighteen-pointed array was instantly formed, completely sealing off the void of the heaven and earth and the rock formations of the earth.
The formation began to operate, and the absorbed pure spiritual energy continued to flow into the ancestor's body along the formation lines, and the ancestor's cultivation aura became stronger moment by moment.
The sleeping green dragon in the underground space was awakened by this tyrannical force of confinement, and a vigorous dragon roar burst out from the depths of the ground. Immediately afterwards, a blue dragon nearly fifty feet long soared out of the sinkhole, trying to break through the seal and escape. However, as soon as it soared to a height of a hundred feet, it hit the thick formation barrier. The huge force of the collision was rebounded by the barrier, and the huge dragon body staggered back more than ten feet due to the force of the counter-shock.
Qinglong turned his huge head, fixed his ferocious gaze on the ancestor and Qin Feng, spoke human words, and said angrily: "A small human race dares to kill this god!"
The ancestor looked calm and said with a faint smile: "May I ask, senior, what is your connection with the Starry Sky Azure Dragon Clan?"
Qinglong was shocked and asked in surprise: "How do you know about the Xingkong Qinglong clan?"
But before he finished speaking, a spatial crack suddenly tore open in the void behind the ancestor, and a green dragon claw protruded from the crack, reaching straight for the ancestor's heart.
Qin Feng on the side reacted quickly, the storage ring flashed, and a golden ball burst out of the air, instantly turning into a golden spider ten feet in size. The four sharp spider legs on the right volleyed towards the incoming dragon claws. There was a harsh sound of gold and iron, and the void trembled. The green dragon's giant claws retreated from the crack in the void; the golden silk spider was also shaken back by the huge force of the collision by more than a foot before it stabilized its body.
Qinglong's vertical pupils shrank and he said in surprise: "It's actually a half-step holy weapon! I didn't expect you to have a half-step holy weapon. It's a pity that your cultivation is not enough, so you can only activate 70% of the power of this holy weapon."
At this moment, a large array of spiritual light surged, and the array patterns connected with the meridians all over the ancestor's body to take shape. The ancestor has entered the realm where people are the formation and the formation is the person. If the great formation also becomes the source of spiritual power, as long as the formation is not broken, the spiritual power in the body will not be exhausted. At the same time, with the help of the formation, the ancestor's cultivation also climbed to the peak of the early stage of Jade Clear Realm, and the pressure that permeated his body swept across all directions.
The Sky-Breaking Sword burst out of the ancestor's dantian. The ancestor held the sword in his right hand and used the "Aoki Mysterious Fire Sutra" mental method with all his strength. The pure wood and fire spiritual power was continuously injected into the Sky-Breaking Sword. The red black fire on the blade suddenly surged, becoming several times more powerful than before.
The ancestor pinched the formation technique with his left hand, thousands of formation patterns circulated rapidly, and majestic wood and fire spiritual power rushed out along the large formation formation patterns.
The void trembled, and countless wood-fire spears were condensed and formed out of thin air. The spears were made of green wood and the flames were the blades. They were densely packed and covered the sky. They were like rain of arrows pouring down from the sky, bombarding the green dragon with a devastating force.
The green dragon looked up to the sky and roared. The vigorous dragon roar carried the scorching dragon's breath, and faced the wood fire spears coming from the sky. There were continuous explosions in the sky, and countless wooden fire spears collided with the sound waves carrying the dragon's breath and exploded, turning into sparks all over the sky and dissipating, and the offensive was completely neutralized.
Chapter 137 Fierce Battle with Qinglong
Taking advantage of this gap, the ancestor grasped the Sky-Breaking Sword tightlyHe rushed forward and yelled: "Duan Yue!" A ten-foot-long red sword light with unparalleled power struck directly at the vital points of Qinglong's abdomen, which had relatively weak defense.
Qinglong grabbed his right front paw in the air and hit the sword from the front. The red sword light struck the scales, and the harsh sound of gold and iron echoed. The huge dragon body only shook slightly; but the ancestor was counterattacked by the huge force, and his body retreated several feet before he could stabilize his body.
Qinglong's murderous intention surged, and his left front paw grabbed the ancestor with strong wind. The ancestor communicated with the formation with a thought, and his body turned into an afterimage to avoid this fatal grasp. Then there was a loud shout: "Split the sky!" A long, narrow and sharp red sword light tore through the void, cutting straight into the vital parts of the dragon's neck.
The dragon's tail swept across and hit the red sword light. The two powerful forces collided head-on, causing the mountains to tremble, the clouds to surge, and the violent spiritual shock waves to spread wantonly, kicking up gravel and dust all over the sky.
Qin Feng immediately activated the earth-attribute golden elixir in his dantian, condensing a thick layer of earth-yellow spiritual power light film on the body surface, protecting the whole body like armor. Immediately, with a thought, thunder pill lightning surged, crackling thunder arcs wrapped around the body, and the body turned into a beam of lightning, and the next moment it appeared at the weak defense point under Qinglong's waist.
Qin Feng once again activated the golden spiritual power in the metallic golden elixir, and the cold wind double moon halberd in his hand instantly glowed with golden light, and the sharp energy leaking from the tip of the halberd easily split the void. He unleashed the seventh form of the Overlord Halberd Technique with all his strength - swallowing the sky and destroying the earth.
In an instant, the halberd turned into a ferocious golden halberd. Its attack was fierce and unstoppable, and it stabbed hard on the scales on the belly of the green dragon. With a crisp sound, the hard and thick dragon scales shattered, and the halberd blade penetrated deeply into the flesh of the abdomen.
The halberd in Qin Feng's hand slashed down, and the sound of flesh tearing could be clearly heard. The hard green dragon's abdominal scales were cut open with a wound that was more than ten feet long. Hot dragon blood spurted out along the wound, dyeing a large area of ​​the void red.
Qinglong raised his head and let out a roar of pain. But the next moment, a green aura lingered around the wound, and the spurting dragon's blood stopped instantly. The damaged skin and flesh shrank and healed at a speed visible to the naked eye, and the huge wound returned to its original state in an instant.
While Qinglong was healing his wounds, the Golden Silk Spider suddenly attacked from the left. With a neighing sound, it suddenly opened its mouth, and tens of thousands of golden threads spurted out, like tens of thousands of sharp arrows piercing the dragon's scales.
A thick layer of green light immediately appeared on the surface of the dragon scales. The usually sharp and unstoppable gold threads were pierced on the green light, but they were unable to break through the green light's defense. However, under the control of the weapon spirit, the golden thread is extremely flexible and can swim along the dragon's body like a spiritual snake.
Qinglong's body is huge, and the surrounding space is imprisoned by a large formation, so the space for movement is narrow. Even though its divine power was overwhelming, there was no way to avoid it. In just a few breaths, the waist was tightly bound by gold threads.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, the ancestor's figure turned into an afterimage and appeared above Qinglong's head in an instant. He poured all the power gathered from his lifelong cultivation and the formation into the Sky-Breaking Sword in his hand. Red flames surged from the blade, and the killing energy shook the void. A sharp shout was heard: "Breaking the Sky!"
A red sword light cut through the air with destructive power and went straight for Qinglong's head. Qinglong's eyes sharpened with ferocious light, he roared angrily, opened his huge mouth, and spit out majestic dragon breath.
The two most powerful forces collided suddenly, and a large area of ​​void collapsed. The cracks continued to spread like a spider web. After a breath, they slowly healed.
